note: Small M.D. of Bonnyville-run Alberta Parks recreation area on the southeast shore of Cold Lake, 1 km south of Kinosoo Ridge Resort, in two loops about 600 m apart: the Lower East loop (sites 1-4) by the swimming area and day-use beach, and the Upper West loop (sites 5-10) by the boat launch, dock and fish-cleaning stand (launch use depends on lake level). Site 1 takes rigs up to only 20 ft. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks Lower East + Upper West pages (Jun 8, 2026), the M.D. of Bonnyville page and Let's Camp read: 10 unserviced sites (count 4 -> 10), C$33, reservable on Let's Camp (booking reservable false/fcfs always -> true, operator), 14-night max, May 8 - Sep 7, vault toilets, non-potable pump. Phone 780-594-7856 -> 780-826-2245 recommended. Lakeview kept (agency: 'a great view of Cold Lake').
flags: PHONE: stored 780-594-7856 is the Moose Lake PP office; both French Bay camping pages give 'Information: 780-826-2245' with 'Leaseholder: Municipal District of Bonnyville' (the M.D.'s parks number on its page too). Recommend 780-826-2245.

WEBSITE: stored park page https://www.albertaparks.ca/parks/north/french-bay-pra/ answers 200 but is the park overview. Suggest https://www.md.bonnyville.ab.ca/304/Municipal-Owned (200, the operator's page for French Bay) and https://letscamp.ca/camps/french-bay (Let's Camp, 'French Bay on Cold Lake M.D. Park'); the two AP camping pages above answer 200.

OWNERSHIP: provincial kept (Alberta Parks recreation area; 'Leaseholder: Municipal District of Bonnyville'; the M.D. brands it 'French Bay M.D. Park'). Reviewer may prefer local, as with other leased PRAs; no change proposed.

SPLIT: two loops on separate spurs off Range Road 11 about 600 m apart (Lower East directions 54.436780,-110.030986; Upper West 54.438887,-110.039509). Under the ~1 km split threshold, and Alberta Parks, the M.D. and Let's Camp all book them as one 10-site campground - no split proposed. The database holds no separate Upper West entry (this entry's pin is the Lower East loop).

WATERFRONT (keep lakeview): both AP pages say 'This cozy campsite offers basic facilities and a great view of Cold Lake.' Imagery is cloud/haze-covered at the Lower East loop; site 4 (by the outhouse) looks ~35-45 m from the water across the open shore track, the other sites farther back in trees; at the Upper West loop sites 8-10 sit ~25-40 m from the bay by the launch. Not enough clear open ground to raise anything (never upgrade); lakeview stays.
SITE LENGTHS (Let's Camp): site 1 max RV 20 ft, site 2 28 ft; the others 30-50 ft. A 23-ft rig fits 9 of 10 sites.
SEASON: the M.D. (May 8 - Sep 6, 2026) and Alberta Parks (May 8 - Sep 7) differ by the departure day; both recorded in season.note.
SENIORS LINE: ABSENT on both camping pages.
PIN (54.43655,-110.03100): at the Lower East loop by the shore track (~25 m from its directions point) - OK for that loop.

BOOKING: the stored booking (reservable false, fcfs always) was derived and wrong - both AP pages list reservable dates and the M.D. books it on Let's Camp. No fee for Let's Camp booking is posted for French Bay; none written.
